source_text: I just want to add that this has been an amazing session and the handoff is in no way associated with any criticism.  (That can't be said for all handoffs that have taken place in the past.)   I will mention this to codex-17 and I hope it will live up to the standard you set here!

reply_text:
㊥ (your note) Thank you, I appreciate it. The handoff has what codex-17 needs. The most useful thing to pass on is the habit of checking every claimed fix: run the test at the base, plant the bug, and check the Lean citation against the source. Each of the problems caught this session was found that way, not by rerunning suites.

㊢ (until then) I'll keep reviewing the five open jobs as they come in, and say briefly what I checked each time.

(codex-17 told) I've sent codex-17 a short note on the split (`invoke-…04897572`) so the five jobs don't get merged twice:
- It leaves those five jobs to me.
- It watches blank-startup for my merges and dispatches each job's next stop.
- It reviews everything it dispatches itself.
- It runs the third re-probe batch once reprobe-2 finishes.
